strengths: Eleven source-specific tabs separate masters, histories, populations, postings, trial balance, and close preparation.
Filters, frozen panes, and print areas reinforce a source-system export lifecycle.
Existing package QC found source-specific layouts usable and differentiated.
defects: Only 591 populated cells across eleven tabs; several source populations are visibly sparse.
Not a complete analyst workpaper and intentionally contains no formulas.
confidence_limits: Review used native OOXML metrics and stored renders, not a live ERP export comparison.

patterns: Separate source populations by originating module and retain system-like field order.
Use a small close-preparation/control tab beside raw export tabs.
Vary row density by population instead of normalizing every sheet.
prohibited_content: All entity names, identifiers, dates, values, accounting conclusions, and source-specific codes.
sanitization: Rebuild from a new world schema; increase population depth where the workflow warrants it; replace every identifier and value.
proof_gate: Recalculate source totals, inspect every sheet, compare field order with the new source-system specification, and run leakage review.
